actual.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM football.match_heatmaps h JOIN football.player_profile_versions p ON p.player_id=h.player_id AND p.source_id=h.source_id AND p.source_record_id=h.source_record_id AND p.variant_key=h.variant_key AND p.profile_context='match_heatmap_observation' AND ingest.selected_at(h.recorded_from_gen,p.recorded_from_gen,p.recorded_to_gen) WHERE h.id=%s
